note: A 1555 Glossary of 2026. Approved entries only. Keep each under ~140 characters, last sentence a surprise.

terms.def: A machine that writes poems for you so you have more time to do the dishes. It does not do the dishes.
An invisible monk who decides what you see. He has never met you. He knows you love videos of dogs.
Gold that lives in the air. I bought some once. It is still in the air.
Breakfast that slept in and now charges more.
A short prayer said shortly before a bigger dip.
Where your paintings are kept. I looked up. They are not there.
The only honest unit of account. A croissant has never once been pegged to anything.
Twice a year a man moves the sun by one hour. Nobody knows who he is.
Reading the prophecies of strangers until two in the morning. I do this professionally.
Merchants explain why the gold is late. Then everyone says great quarter, guys.
A basket of many companies, so you can lose money in all of them at once, efficiently.
A tavern where the carriage drinks and the man buys a sandwich he will regret.
When the croissant gets smaller and the price gets bigger. In 1555 we called this the baker.
A town crier who is paid in free shampoo.
The price of borrowing money. The Fed sets it. I set mine at please.
Borrowing money so you can be wrong in a larger size.
A woodcut that travels faster than the plague. I am told this is a compliment.
Small bells that ring all day to tell you nothing has happened.
A secret word the machine asks for. It must contain a number, a symbol and your childhood fear.
Two men talking in a cellar, recorded so it can continue forever.
A collection of decisions you would like to discuss with no one.
Two quarters in a row of everyone saying recession.
A stranger's carriage, summoned by prayer. Afterwards you judge each other out of five stars.
The shop has made you an employee. Your wages are paid in shame.
A rectangle that knows everything and is always at 3%.
A market where nobody sells stockings. I was very disappointed.
Renting a thing forever so you never own it. Like a tenant, but for songs.
Two days when the market sleeps. I do not trust it. It is planning something.
Invisible air that everyone is angry at.

terms.term: Your call is important to us
terms.def: A spell. It means the opposite.
